name: Wolfram Leisegang
original_name: ヴォルフラム・ライゼガング
source:
Star Sign: Aries

He chose to fight for his country and got thrown into a swirling conflict.
He thought that a soldier could only live for fighting and couldn't live a normal life, but after he met [url=/c45343]Ludwig[/url] he had a feeling he could start living for something other than fighting.
translation:
Star Sign: Aries

He chose to fight for his country and got thrown into a swirling conflict.
He thought that a soldier could only live for fighting and couldn't live a normal life, but after he met [url=/c45343]Ludwig[/url] he had a feeling he could start living for something other than fighting.
